name: OpenJK
subtitle: Open source Jedi Academy engine. Bring your own game files.

apps.name: OpenJK SP
apps.localizedDescription: Play the Jedi Academy story on iPhone and iPad. Needs the game files from your own PC copy (Steam, GOG or disc): assets0.pk3 to assets3.pk3. Setup guide: https://github.com/Nodman/OpenJK-iOS/blob/ios/docs/ios.md. Not affiliated with Disney, Lucasfilm or Raven Software.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to multiplayer servers on your local network.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to multiplayer servers on your local network.
